build_ast_from_cpp_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and iterate over generated nodes
generate_ast_nodes: generate AST nodes from a C++ token stream using AstBuilder.Generate as a generator
extract_cpp_identifiers: extract and print identifiers from a C++ source file using PrintIndentifiers with a predicate
parse_cpp_classes_and_methods: parse C++ class definitions and method signatures into Class and Method AST nodes
process_cpp_files_cli: process one or more C++ files via the CLI main function and print the full AST
